carrera.title: Study plan for Computer Systems and Graphics Engineering
carrera.lede: Learn to build systems, experiences and tools that make a difference.
carrera.description: Computer Systems and Graphics Engineering combines programming, data, graphics and projects so you learn by doing.
carrera.wideTitle: A broad formation for problems that do not yet have a name.
carrera.wideText: You will program, model, analyse and present ideas. The degree moves between technical foundations and projects where you have to make decisions.
carrera.learnDescription: Theory takes shape when you turn it into something that can be tested, explained and improved.

learn.title: Understand
learn.text: Observe a problem, form questions and build a solid base.

learn.title: Build
learn.text: Program, design prototypes and work with tools used outside the classroom.

learn.title: Share
learn.text: Present decisions, receive feedback and work with other people.

carrera.mapText: Ten semesters and 57 courses that chain toward what you will build. {campus}. RVOE {rvoe}. Choose a semester or a course to see what supports it and where it leads.
carrera.trackDescription: Explore these areas in your projects and confirm the current offer with Coordination.
carrera.doubleText: Ask Coordination about availability, the semester of entry, equivalences and the costs of a double degree.
carrera.fieldText: Software, data, visualization, digital product, automation, research and entrepreneurship.

software.name: Software development
software.description: Algorithms, object orientation, data structures, web, databases, operating systems, software engineering, plugins and compilers.

ai.name: Artificial intelligence
ai.description: Data, probability, image processing, AI in video games and models for pattern recognition and decision.

vr.name: Virtual and mixed reality
vr.description: Augmented reality, interfaces, graphical simulation and immersive experiences.

graphics.name: Computer graphics
graphics.description: Digital modeling, multimedia, geometry, conformal geometric algebra, advanced graphics, video games and mobile graphical solutions.

data.name: Data science
data.description: Statistics, numerical methods, distributed and parallel computing, and the data science specialization in the 4+1.
